en: Dear customer, from {col:pricehist.date} the price of {col:pricehist.product} (SKU {col:pricehist.sku}) changes from {col:pricehist.old_price} to {col:pricehist.new_price}, a change of {col:pricehist.change_pct}.
mt: 尊敬的客户，从 {col:pricehist.date}起，{col:pricehist.product}（SKU {col:pricehist.sku}）的价格从 {col:pricehist.old_price} 更改为 {col:pricehist.new_price}，变化为 {col:pricehist.change_pct}。

en: Read Margin by Channel. Each SKU and channel shows the margin, a verdict and the price needed for the target and the floor.
mt: 阅读按渠道划分的保证金。每个 SKU 和渠道都会显示保证金、结论以及目标和底价所需的价格。

en: Type the SKU, the sales per day, the supplier lead time and your safety days; see the reorder point, the point set now and how many days are left before you must order.
mt: 输入 SKU、每日销售额、供应商交货时间和您的安全天数；查看再订购点、现在设置的点以及距离必须订购还剩多少天。
